responsibility: Implements the string-length optimization and warning pass for tree SSA. It tracks string objects and related pointer offsets through dominator order using strinfo records, derives lengths and termination properties of strings built by library calls and stores, folds or rewrites strlen/printf/mem* idioms, optimizes malloc+memset/calloc-style patterns, and emits format and string access diagnostics when optimization or warning-only modes request them.
same_name_distinction: This is the actual strlen/printf optimization-and-diagnostics pass implementation, with dominator-walk state tracking, string-object analysis, statement rewriting, diagnostics, and pass registration. By contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-strlen.h is only the small exported helper interface consumed by this pass and related sprintf/format code.
